verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine and model platform with native tool calling, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions connecting to MCP servers. Its tool support consists of Python-decorated functions and OpenAI-form tool schemas, which are developer building blocks rather than a way to plug in MCP servers, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
